description: This file defines an abstract class TocFaultTransactionTestRunner that extends TransactionTestRunnerBase, providing methods to test transaction behaviors such as commit failure and exceptions within Orleans transaction grains. It includes asynchronous test methods that simulate transaction scenarios and verify outcomes using FluentAssertions.

classes.name: TocFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test methods for transaction failure scenarios in Orleans grains, including commit failure and in-doubt exceptions.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitFailure
methods.description: Simulates a multi-grain transaction with a commit failure, verifying that an OrleansTransactionAbortedException is thrown and that grains' values remain as expected.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitException
methods.description: Simulates a multi-grain transaction with a commit exception, verifying that an OrleansTransactionInDoubtException is thrown and that grains' values remain as expected.
